evidence: Source reads and edits only; no builds, tests, syntax checks, project/game execution, game launch, attachment or process inspection

archive.track: bedrock_body_samples_v6 retains v4 light and v5 material fields, then appends visibility
archive.magic: 0x415243424f440006; legacy v4/v5 remain readable with their original magics
archive.encoding: Existing body frame/actor layout, big endian DataOutput. Each actor appends a strict u8 presence flag and, when present, the exact packed-light int32 after its optional color.
archive.input: WorldFrame.Player.packedLight from the same observed actor/frame as its six-part pose, model root and skin color
archive.bounds: Existing 2 MiB inflated blocks, at most 64 frames and 128 actors; actor size estimate includes the maximum five additional bytes
archive.oldVersions: Mount recognizes body v1 through v6 as mutually exclusive tracks. V1-v3 retain unknown light; v4 adds light, v5 material and v6 visibility.

sampling.ownership: BodySample copies preserve the nullable immutable integer; equality includes its exact value/availability
sampling.endpoints: Exact recorded endpoint returns that endpoint's packed light
sampling.interior: Retain a known packed light only when both endpoints have the same value; otherwise unknown. Never interpolate packed integers or infer a transition time.
sampling.gaps: Existing body reader rejects interpolation across actor absence, discontinuous chunks, missed ticks and long pauses
sampling.playback: WorldFrame uses the selected recorded actor/time BodySample; the viewer's live sample cannot fill absence
sampling.readiness: Appearance capture requires a packed-light sample when body, cape or worn cosmetics require body references. V4 missing/changing-light samples also prevent new body plans via recordedPoseMissing.

limitations: A v4 track may contain unknown samples; format support does not prove captured lighting
